title: Sony's Revamped PS5 Pulse Headset Launches Alongside GTA 6 on Nov 19
description: Sony has confirmed its revamped PlayStation Pulse headset will launch alongside GTA 6 on November 19, with pre-orders starting October 29.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony's Revamped PS5 Pulse Headset Launches Alongside GTA 6 on November 19

As the gaming community eagerly counts down to the launch of Rockstar's highly anticipated blockbuster, hardware manufacturers are aligning their schedules with the game. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, Sony has confirmed that its revamped PlayStation Pulse headset will launch alongside GTA 6 on November 19.

For players looking to upgrade their audio experience to fully immerse themselves in the rich, detailed audio landscape of GTA 6, this newly revamped headset aims to deliver enhanced sound performance. Whether it's the ambient sounds of the city streets, vehicle engine roars, or critical in-game dialogue, the upgraded hardware is positioned as an ideal companion for the release.

### Pre-Order Schedule and Availability

According to details shared on the PS Blog, pricing and pre-order arrangements have been officially set:

* **Pre-Order Start Date**: Next week, beginning on October 29 at 10 AM local time.
* **Official Store**: Pre-orders will open directly on PS Direct.
* **Retail Partners**: The PS Blog notes that the headset will also be available through "participating retailers," which is expected to include major platforms like Amazon and Best Buy.

With pre-orders kicking off next week, fans who want to secure their hardware setup ahead of the game's launch will have a clear window of opportunity.

### Editor's Take

Synchronizing a hardware refresh with one of the biggest entertainment launches in history is a classic strategic move. While the headset aims to enhance the audio immersion of GTA 6, players should weigh their personal audio preferences and setup needs before jumping into pre-orders next week.
